title: Dance / movement painting
summary: One shared Holistic stream becomes ribbons, stitched steps, a moving loom, hand accents and face-driven ornament.

steps.title: Prepare the dancer
steps.text: Use + on the film source to load a dance/movement film and press ▶. The local copy uses Serpentine Dance; try Sandow or a clear contemporary dancer when fabric hides joints.
steps.hint: No camera, media playback, model download or inference is started by lesson actions. Camera users can replace the film source explicitly.

steps.title: Start one shared Holistic stream
steps.text: Press ▶ on the Holistic provider after its assets are installed (↓ downloads them if needed). It publishes danceBody with body, face and both hands. All other nodes reuse it.
steps.hint: The selected feature list never causes another model run. Clean image, observations and diagnostic overlay are separate outputs.

steps.title: Check the source / landmark match
steps.text: Turn on the source underlay and point IDs in the Measures viewer. Examine wrists, ankles and the torso. The anatomical map is a selection reference, not the detected pose.
steps.hint: Missing/occluded joints are unavailable; their strokes stop instead of jumping to (0,0). Lower confidence only after inspecting the source.

steps.title: Four pens, one moving loom
steps.text: Run Livecode if it is not running. Teal/pink wrist ribbons, orange/blue ankle stitches and torso-centroid spokes weave the dancer's path into a paper-like painting.
steps.hint: Point positions place the pens; torso/face groups define centroids. Source and strokes share aspect-preserving framing.

steps.title: Change the gesture's handwriting
steps.text: Compare direct following with soft interpolation. Adjust brush_size, energy_gain and pigment: faster movement widens ribbons, while slower movement makes fine lines.
steps.hint: Smoothing changes drawing motion, not the detector. Source timestamps, source-change checks and missing-point breaks protect the stroke.

steps.title: Time as paint
steps.text: Try a short trail, then switch accumulate on to keep the whole movement painting. Pause the film to hold the composition; R clears the ink layer.
steps.hint: A held source neither ages the paint nor advances event holds. A missing source preserves the last painting without inventing movement.

steps.title: Edit spatial zones
steps.text: Move or resize the shared center/left/right boxes. Torso-in-zone measures bias color; entering the center adds a rosette. Observe stage::center in the ledger.
steps.hint: Editor zoom/pan affects navigation only. The boxes remain normalized to the complete source. Polygons/region layers can follow later.

steps.title: Distance and segment geometry
steps.text: Watch reach.distance between wrists: it opens/closes the torso halo. The two index-finger segments can trigger a crossing rosette when they intersect in 2D.
steps.hint: Distances use image-height units with aspect correction. Crossing is projected segment intersection, not proof of physical 3D contact.

steps.title: Hands write accents
steps.text: Open hands add petal ornaments; finger count shifts color. A fist lifts its wrist pen; thumbs gently turn the palette. Pinch a thumb/index pair, then release to stamp a click accent.
steps.hint: Geometric hand estimates are not trained gesture classes. Inspect handL.valid / handR.valid and adjust close/open/hold/cooldown. Serpentine fabric often hides hands; absence is not a fist.

steps.title: Face signals without pretending
steps.text: Mouth aperture enlarges brush/halo energy, blinks add face-centered ornaments, and iris-in-eye x gently biases color. The optional lookTarget stays invalid until empirical calibration ranges are supplied.
steps.hint: Iris tracking does not provide a reliable gaze target. Use a closer source for face details; the painting continues with body-only signals.

steps.title: Author a new relation
steps.text: Select a group on the map, save a locator with +, add a measure with ⊕ and bind A/B/C/D with ◎. Add a threshold event or contact envelope, or edit the shared JSON in {}.
steps.hint: The editor and script-like JSON produce the same saved plan. __.streams.read("movement").features reads values; __.events.on("pinchL.click", ...) subscribes to pulses.

steps.title: Make your own movement painting
steps.text: Try slower playback, stronger pigment, long accumulation, different zones or a different dancer. Turn off the source underlay and export the final PNG.
steps.hint: HTML/ZIP exports package the sketch, not the Comfy graph or MediaPipe streams. Record/provide those streams separately for a standalone replay.
